What to look for: the parameter of f() is a B, but a C is passed to it.
That derived-to-base conversion is what breaks codegen.

  DXC   crashes (SIGSEGV on Compiler Explorer; an LLVM assert in a local
        debug build). No diagnostic, no output.
  Clang compiles the same source cleanly.

Change f's parameter from B to C and DXC compiles it, which isolates the
conversion rather than the inheritance itself.

Restated as a compute shader so Clang can run the same source; the issue's
original repro is a ps_6_0 and crashes identically.
